# LAMMPS input script for bulk Aluminum energy calculation

units metal
atom_style atomic

# Read the structure
read_data al_bulk.data

# Replicate the unit cell 5x5x5
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe ke etotal press vol density
minimize 1.0e-8 1.0e-10 10000 100000

variable pe_per_atom equal "pe/v_natoms"

variable ly equal "ly"

print "PE per atom: ${pe_per_atom}"
print "Box dimensions: ${lx} ${ly} ${lz}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3

# Calculate surface energy for Aluminum [0,0,1] surface

# Data from simulations
pe_bulk_per_atom = -3.35972550716004  # eV
pe_surface_per_atom = -3.26362193687551  # eV
natoms = 500
lx = 20.19465  # Angstroms
ly = 20.19465  # Angstroms

# Calculate total energies
E_bulk = natoms * pe_bulk_per_atom
E_surface = natoms * pe_surface_per_atom

# Calculate surface area (in x-y plane)
area = lx * ly

# Calculate surface energy
# Factor of 2 because we create two surfaces (top and bottom)
surface_energy = (E_surface - E_bulk) / (2 * area)

print(f"Bulk PE per atom: {pe_bulk_per_atom} eV")
print(f"Surface PE per atom: {pe_surface_per_atom} eV")
print(f"Total bulk energy: {E_bulk} eV")
print(f"Total surface energy: {E_surface} eV")
print(f"Energy difference: {E_surface - E_bulk} eV")
print(f"Surface area: {area} Ų")
print(f"Surface energy: {surface_energy} eV/Ų")
print(f"\nFinal answer: {surface_energy:.2f}")
